item.title: Godot's Core: Unpacking the Node-Based Architecture and C++ Extensibility
item.description: Godot’s Core: Unpacking the Node-Based Architecture and C++ Extensibility Godot Engine has rapidly ascended as a prominent open-source game development platform, celebrated for its intuitive editor and expressive scripting language. While its user-friendliness is often highlighted, a true understanding of Godot’s power lies beneath the surface – in its elegant architectural patterns, efficient resource management, and robust extensibility mechanisms. This deep dive will pull back the curtain, exploring the “how” and “why” behind Godot’s design choices, from its fundamental scene tree to its C++ module system.
